library(plumber)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)

#* @get /sites
function(hood = "Roxbury") {
  tbl(con, "joined_q") %>%
    filter(neighborhood == hood) %>%
    count(cell, group) %>%
    collect()
}
code.sql:
CREATE VIEW joined_q AS
SELECT p.id, p.grp, c.cell, c.neighborhood
FROM points p
JOIN cells c ON ST_Within(p.geom, c.geom);
